newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-First Australian sees big U.S. flow.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-First Australian sees big U.S. flow.

text.p: Oil and gas explorer First Australian Resources N.L. said on Monday significant oil and gas flows had been reported at its South Louisiana well in the United States.

It said state lease 3258's number one well at South Lake Raccourci in south Louisiana had been perforated and flow tested between 15,509 feet and 15,520 feet and had tested at a rate of 5.26 million cubic feet of gas and 687 barrels of oil per day.
"This is the best flow test recorded by First Australian Resources since commencing exploration activity in the United States," First Australian said.
"Production facilities are presently being installed and the well is expected to be placed on line during January 1997 at rates approximating the flow test," it said.
Following a trade with Exxon USA, under which Exxon agreed to pay 40 percent of the costs of the well to earn a 25 percent stake, an additional 320 acres was acquired within the field.
"As a result of the trade with Exxon, First Australian Resources, pre-completion working interest in the SL 3258 1 well is now 4.18 percent," it said.
The remaining working interests include Goodrich Petroleum, Exxon and Apache Corp.
